title: T2SPO: Trajectory-to-Step Policy Optimization for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.00388v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning enables large language model (LLM) agents to learn multi-step behaviors through interaction with their environments. However, rewards in many interactive tasks reflect only the final outcome, providing limited guidance on which intermediate decisions advance the task. Successful training trajectories contain intermediate states that can provide supervision for subsequent interactions. We introduce Trajectory-to-Step Policy Optimization (T2SPO), a method that uses past interaction trajectories to provide step-level feedback for policy learning. T2SPO derives remaining-distance targets from successful trajectories and pairs them with representations of the states visited along the way. Conditioned on these examples, a pretrained TabPFN regressor estimates the remaining distance to success at each state of a new rollout. translated_title: T2SPO：面向智能体强化学习的轨迹到步骤策略优化
translated_abstract: 强化学习使大语言模型（LLM）智能体能够通过与环境的交互来学习多步行为。然而，许多交互式任务中的奖励仅反映最终结果，对于哪些中间决策能够推进任务所提供的指导十分有限。成功的训练轨迹中包含可以为后续交互提供监督信号的中间状态。我们提出了轨迹到步骤策略优化（T2SPO），这是一种利用过往交互轨迹为策略学习提供步骤级反馈的方法。T2SPO从成功轨迹中推导出剩余距离目标，并将其与沿途所访问状态的表示相配对。在这些样本的条件下，一个预训练的TabPFN回归器可以估计新采样轨迹（rollout）中每个状态距离成功的剩余步数。该距离估计在相邻状态之间的变化，为智能体的每一步提供辅助的信用分配信号。
tldr: 提出T2SPO方法，通过从成功历史轨迹中学习并用预训练的TabPFN回归器估计每个状态距离成功的剩余步数，为只有最终结果奖励的多步智能体强化学习任务提供步骤级的信用分配反馈。
en_tdlr: T2SPO leverages past successful trajectories and a pretrained TabPFN regressor to estimate the remaining distance to success at each state, providing step-level credit assignment for agentic RL tasks where rewards reflect only final outcomes.
